card.name: Small words in fixed warning phrases
card.fires_on: Short linking words (of, to, first, in, 's) or the start of 'triptans' inside stock warning sentences in drug labels, such as stopping-treatment, seek-attention and first-appearance-of-rash phrases.

modes.label: Linking word in warning phrase
modes.description: A small word like 'of', 'to' or 'in' within a stock safety instruction.
modes.example: Advise patients<< to>> seek immediate medical attention for suicidal ideation

modes.label: First appearance of rash
modes.description: The word 'first' in 'at the first appearance of skin rash'.
modes.example: to discontinue the use of naproxen tablets or naproxen sodium tablets at the<< first>> appearance of skin rash or any other sign

modes.label: Inside drug-class or name lists
modes.description: Start of 'triptans' or the 's in St. John's Wort within interaction lists.

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in standard label warnings, like 'within 7 days of stopping' or 'advise patients to seek'.
